source: held-out validation, years 2013/2017/2021/2025 (reports/validation_final.md); nmae = sum|error| / sum(observed S-NPP); modis_ta daily from reports/validation_hybrid.md
how_to_pick: Per day use coverage.regime; for regime 3 (viirs) check coverage.mask bit 4 (S-NPP): set -> direct S-NPP, clear -> NOAA-20-filled.

viirs_snpp.note: reference sensor; only detection limits (clouds, overpass time) apply
